newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African police defuse bomb.
newsitem.headline: South African police defuse bomb.

text.p: South African police defused a bomb in a bank at a holiday resort on Tuesday, but do not believe it is linked to recent right-wing bomb attacks which have killed four blacks.
The bank in Amanzimtoti, 20 km (12 miles) south of the port city of Durban, was evacuated after a telephone call warning of a bomb, a police spokesman said.
"The police were called in to investigate a suspicious package and found commercial explosives linked to a timing device and a battery," the spokesman said.

A bomb-squad member said there was no link to the Christmas Eve pipe bomb blasts in the farming town of Worcester northeast of Cape Town which killed four blacks, nor to the three explosions earlier this month in a mining town northwest of Johannesburg.
"There is no connection and at this stage we don't know what the motive is," the policeman said.
